references.text: Describes the same event where the beloved disciple leans back on Jesus' chest to ask who will betray him.
Parallel account of the last meal where Jesus reveals that one of the disciples will betray him, and the disciples ask who it is.
Describes the same situation at the dinner table where Jesus says that one of them will betray him, and the disciples ask each other who it could be.
Reports on Jesus warning about the betrayal at the meal, and the disciples wonder among themselves which of them will do it.
